artifact: Frozen native Sessions/People round-3: all 10 uncropped iPhone 17 / iOS 26.5 PNGs
scenario: A time-constrained independent recruiter juggling several live searches must find and reopen the right person or conversation on a phone.
evidence_scope: Direct full-viewport visual inspection of every PNG, including navigation, search, utility labels and the fixed composer. Behavior is known only through review-input.md's supplied summary; no Simulator interaction, source review, prior round or other review was consulted.

categories.name: Attention and clarity
evidence: 01-sessions-light.png: topic is the bold first line; Leila Hartmann and Chief Product Officer search remain together below it; the red Review needed label is separate from recency.

02-sessions-unread-light.png: Leila has both an explicit Unread label and Review needed; 05-sessions-dark-zh.png shows Leila read/needs review and Nia unread without review attention, visibly separating the two states.
03-people-light.png and 06-people-dark-zh.png: the two names lead, with job/company and search context underneath; preview status is a quiet count-row label rather than a banner.

deductions.observation: The recency value has no visible event label. It is readable but leaves the recruiter to infer what became two weeks old.
deductions.evidence: 01-sessions-light.png: both session footers say only 2 wk. ago. 03-people-light.png: both person footers say Candidate · 2 wk. ago. 05-sessions-dark-zh.png and 06-people-dark-zh.png retain the same unqualified 2周前 value.
deductions.impact: When several searches are active, the date cannot by itself distinguish last contact, last session activity or a record update. This is a visible-label ambiguity, not evidence that the stored time is wrong.

categories.name: Typography and legibility
evidence: 01-sessions-light.png through 06-people-dark-zh.png: titles/names are strong, secondary context is readable, and no essential label is ellipsized.
07-sessions-ax5.png and 09-sessions-ax5-scrolled.png: large session text wraps at words; the continuation exposes Review needed and 2 wk. ago.
08-people-ax5.png and 10-people-ax5-scrolled.png: full person and search labels are retained with large readable type.

deductions.observation: At AX5, inline dot-separated metadata becomes a long multiline phrase whose field boundaries are less deliberate than the compact rows.
deductions.evidence: 08-people-ax5.png: VP Product · ends one line before Meridian Labs, while Candidate · Chief Product Officer search spans three lines. 10-people-ax5-scrolled.png: Operating Partner · Northlight Capital spans four lines and Candidate · ends a line before the three-line search context.
deductions.impact: The words remain legible, but the recruiter must parse where job, organization, relationship role and search context change. The deduction concerns grouping, not the need for large-type scrolling.

categories.name: Alignment and rhythm
evidence: 01-sessions-light.png and 02-sessions-unread-light.png: row text and trailing menus preserve their alignment when the unread surface appears.
03-people-light.png, 04-people-filter.png and 06-people-dark-zh.png: initials, names, subordinate lines and inset dividers form coherent row groups; the one-result page remains honestly sparse.

07-sessions-ax5.png through 10-people-ax5-scrolled.png: large text uses the available width without the compact avatar column. Partial text at viewport boundaries is ordinary scroll continuation, confirmed by the supplied paired positions, and is not export clipping.

categories.name: Restraint and material
evidence: 01-sessions-light.png and 02-sessions-unread-light.png: read rows are flat; a single soft surface identifies the unread session without redundant chevrons.
05-sessions-dark-zh.png: warm dark material retains an explicit unread label, a restrained raised row, and a separate review color.
03-people-light.png and 06-people-dark-zh.png: neutral initials, separators and ellipsis menus support the names without candidate scoring or decorative badges.

deductions.observation: The full-width fixed Ask anything composer remains a second prominent input surface during focused retrieval, including at AX5.
deductions.evidence: 07-sessions-ax5.png through 10-people-ax5-scrolled.png: Search sessions/Search people stays at the top while the rounded Ask anything bar, plus and waveform remain at the bottom. 09 shows the next session starting just above that persistent bar; 10 shows recency continuing beyond the list viewport above it. The same separate composer is present in 01 through 06.
deductions.impact: The generic prompt takes visible space and emphasis during a specific find-and-reopen job. This is a subjective shell-priority refinement, not a claim that the content is unreachable or obscured permanently.

categories.name: System coherence
evidence: 01-sessions-light.png and 03-people-light.png share search/filter placement, count/preview row, navigation and menu alignment.
04-people-filter.png shows a filled active filter icon, a named Chief Product Officer search chip with an explicit x, and the singular 1 person count.
05-sessions-dark-zh.png and 06-people-dark-zh.png retain identity, localized controls and readable context in the same structure.
07-sessions-ax5.png through 10-people-ax5-scrolled.png retain selected-page treatment, readable search labels, count/preview status and person/session menu glyphs while rows scroll.

score_interpretation: Subjective visual craft judgment using the frozen anchors: polished with three specific residual refinements. It is neither measured recruiter preference nor an average with other reviewers.

highest_impact_corrections.correction: Give recency a short event label that accurately matches the existing stored timestamp; preserve the actual time semantics.

highest_impact_corrections.correction: At AX5, separate role/company and relationship/search context at intentional field boundaries rather than relying on inline dots across multiple lines; preserve readable type and every field.

highest_impact_corrections.verification: Recapture both People AX5 positions with the same content and confirm distinct field groups, full labels and unchanged content access.

functional_gates.status: Reported passing where covered by review-input.md; not independently executed in this review
functional_gates.reported_evidence: review-input.md reports focused policy tests, native search/filter/reset and long-list restoration checks, unread/attention composition, a native 44-point menu with only 0.001-point numerical tolerance, localized role search, reduced-motion/menu access, and CUA content readback/scrolling.
functional_gates.visible_support: 04 shows an active scope with a reset affordance; 01/02/05 distinguish read state from review attention; 09/10 show subsequent content positions.
missing_proof: The raw native test results and CUA transcript were not independently inspected; still images do not prove tap behavior, navigation, search correctness, reset behavior, target sizes or menu hit testing.

No end-to-end identity/provenance audit or external-write trace was supplied within the frozen images; the review-input statement that these semantics were not intentionally changed is not an independent audit.
Rendered VoiceOver conformance, realistic large archives, same-name people, and observed recruiter time-to-target remain unproven.
functional_gates.relationship_to_score: Missing proof has not been converted into visual deductions. This craft score cannot override a failed functional gate.
